name: Transportation Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
benefit: Loans are provided on an individual basis to purchase auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. - Maximum Loan Limit: ₹2,00,000/- - Interest Rate: 6% per annum - Loan Amount: 95% of the vehicle cost - Beneficiary Contribution: 5% of the vehicle cost
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
